t: This is a community centre named for Sojourner Truth. She was an American abolitionist and activist for African-American civil rights, women's rights and alcohol temperance. Born into slavery in Swartekill, New York, she escaped with her infant daughter to freedom in 1826. In 1828 she went to court to recover her son, and became the first Black woman to win such a case against a white man. The centre carries her name to honour that story.
